cases.goal: Open a new tab in Safari with the keyboard

steps.target: the sidebar button (pokaż pasek boczny) in the toolbar
steps.expect: the sidebar is shown at the left of the window

steps.target: the sidebar button (ukryj pasek boczny) in the toolbar
steps.expect: the sidebar is no longer shown

steps.target: the tab overview button (Podgląd kart) in the toolbar
steps.expect: the tab overview with thumbnails of the open tabs is shown

cases.goal: Leave the tab overview in Safari
Go to Polish Wikipedia in Safari

steps.target: the address field (inteligentne pole wyszukiwania) in the toolbar

steps.expect: the Wikipedia main page is shown

steps.target: the Wikipedia search field on the page (Przeszukaj Wikipedię)

steps.expect: the article about Mikołaj Kopernik is shown

cases.goal: Go back one page in Safari

steps.target: the Back button (Wróć) in the toolbar
steps.expect: the Wikipedia main page is shown

cases.goal: Go forward one page in Safari

steps.target: the Forward button (Idź dalej) in the toolbar
steps.expect: the article about Mikołaj Kopernik is shown

cases.goal: Close the current tab in Safari
